yearRound.title: Year-Round Programs
yearRound.subtitle: 8 specialized departments available all year
yearRound.description: Ongoing specialized tracks in the depths of technology — start anytime and progress at your own pace.

faq.question: Does my child need prior experience to enroll?
faq.answer: No prior experience is needed for entry-level programs. Each department has beginner tracks designed to start from zero. If your child has some background, we assess them and place them in the right level.

faq.question: How many hours per week and what is the schedule?
faq.answer: Most programs run 2 sessions per week, each 1.5 to 2 hours. You can choose morning or evening slots. The schedule is flexible and can be arranged at enrollment.

faq.question: How long does each level take to complete?
faq.answer: Each level is approximately 12–16 hours of instruction, which takes around 6–8 weeks at 2 sessions per week. Students progress to the next level after passing a practical assessment.

faq.question: Is there a certificate at the end?
faq.answer: Yes. Students who complete each level and pass the practical assessment receive an official Robotrick certificate for that level.

faq.question: What does my child need to bring?
faq.answer: Nothing — all equipment, kits, and materials are provided at the center. Just bring a notebook if they like taking notes.
